title: the question tool's both-ends probe reads the artifact trail, not the index
intention: both_ends_agree reads every question and answer event from artifact.read_trail, so an open and its answer on one question file are both seen. The trail is per box and keeps 30 days; this reader sees only that, and says so.
traces_to: Law 3: a probe that sees one event per question file cannot measure whether both ends agreed.
how: Swap the probe's journal read for door.read_trail(root). The docstring and the finding name the 30-day, per-box horizon. It builds after b15da5656579 lands, which adds read_trail and the index.

clauses.claim: one question opened and answered through a scratch world's door gives the probe both events
the probe's finding names the 30-day horizon

why: Split from b15da5656579 under RULE 1. After b15d the journal holds only the newest entry per path and every entry is in a day trail on this box for 30 days.
